problem_statement: The POSIX times() function, part of the POSIX multi-process option group, is not implemented. A caller that includes <sys/times.h> and calls times() with a buffer of type struct tms should have the buffer filled with the accumulated user-CPU time and the system, child-user and child-system time fields, and should receive a non-negative return value (the elapsed real time) rather than -1. Repeated calls a moment apart should report values that do not move backward, and the returned real time should be no greater than the sum of the reported user and system times.
